measurements_origin: Published 2026-10-24 experiment data; reanalysis only on 2026-10-25. No solver rerun.

statistical_contract.experimental_units: Each original experiment ran in one process; loops within process are descriptive repeats. Continuation stores 31-repeat medians only.
statistical_contract.exclusions: Warmups excluded. All refusal and unresolved rows retained in tables; only accepted comparable cases contribute speed ratios.
statistical_contract.pooling: No pooling across operators, root clients, ODE trajectories or hosts.

polynomial_exact.timing: 11 cyclic >=2ms groups per method in one process; fresh/reused setup separated

polynomial_conditional.timing: 3 in-process calibrated timing groups; calibration and one-time setup excluded, final residual plus fallback included

continuation.comparator: Bisection solves final target only; fixed-P continues lambda=0 to1. Same residual request; attained errors and root-error demands differ where shown.

certification.timing: 9 in-process timed repeats per dimension/method/fixture. Preparation reported separately; direct solution shared mathematically.

amortization.interpretation: descriptive additive-cost projection from medians; not measured repeated-plan crossover; small differences require process-level replication
